title: 할머니께 드려요: 윗사람에게 줄 때, 말할 때
objective: By the end, you can use 께 with 드리다 and other verbs to give things to or contact older or higher-ranking people. You can also tell 께 (to someone) apart from 께서 (the person who does the action).
summary: Learn to use 께, the polite form of 에게/한테, when you give something to or speak to someone you respect, and how it differs from 께서.

task.title: Use 께 correctly
task.line: Read each item, then choose, fill in, correct, rewrite, or put the words in order using 께, 께서, or 에게/한테.

forms.when: Use 께 instead of 에게/한테 when the receiver is someone you respect (grandparents, parents, teachers, your boss). It has the same form after a vowel or a consonant.
forms.exampleMeaning: I sent an email to the department manager.

forms.when: When you give something to an honored person, use 드리다 (polite 'give') instead of 주다.
forms.exampleMeaning: On Lunar New Year, I gave my grandmother some pocket money.

forms.when: When you tell or report something to an honored person, use 말씀드리다 instead of 말하다.
forms.exampleMeaning: I'll tell the company president about that tomorrow.

forms.when: 께서 is the polite form of 이/가: it marks the honored person who does the action. 께 marks the honored person who receives it.
forms.means: 께서 = (honored person) does; 께 = to (honored person)

watchOut: 어머니께 꽃을 줬어요 (X) → 어머니께 꽃을 드렸어요 (O): With 께, use the polite verb 드리다, not 주다.
제가 할머니께서 선물을 드렸어요 (X) → 제가 할머니께 선물을 드렸어요 (O): The grandmother receives the gift, so use 께, not 께서.
동생께 사탕을 줬어요 (X) → 동생에게 사탕을 줬어요 (O): Do not use 께 for younger people, friends, or yourself. Use 에게 or 한테.
exercises: Choose the right word: 저는 어제 (아버지께 / 아버지께서) 넥타이를 드렸어요.
Choose the right word: (사장님께 / 사장님께서) 저에게 새 일을 주셨어요.
Fill in each blank with 께 or 에게: ① 저는 동생____ 우산을 빌려줬어요. ② 저는 할머니____ 편지를 썼어요.
Find the mistake and rewrite the sentence: 저는 생일에 어머니께 꽃을 줬어요.
Rewrite the sentence. The person is now 할머니: 저는 매주 동생한테 전화해요.
Put the words in order to make a sentence: 드렸어요 / 케이크를 / 할아버지께 / 저는
answers: 저는 매주 할머니께 전화해요. (저는 매주 할머니께 전화를 드려요.)
저는 할아버지께 케이크를 드렸어요. (저는 케이크를 할아버지께 드렸어요.)
